title: Secure Password Reset & Magic Links
learningObjectives: Design cryptographically secure, single-use, time-limited reset tokens
Mitigate account enumeration attacks in reset request forms
Invalidate existing active sessions upon successful password changes
keyTradeoffs: Stateless signed tokens (HMAC) vs stored hash in database
Immediate login after reset vs requiring re-authentication
commonPitfalls: Returning distinct HTTP status codes or timing variations for registered vs unregistered emails
Allowing reset tokens to be reused multiple times within the expiry window
transferPrompt: If a compromised email account requests password resets, what additional verification factors would protect the user?
